description:
Are you passionate about human space exploration, understanding the origins of the universe, and working with a passionate and diverse team to make a difference? If you are, we need you!     

 We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. We are excited about what we do, and we need you on our team as we take on exciting challenges for NASA’s pursuits in deep space exploration. As NASA’s largest engineering solutions provider working together with NASA at centers across the United States. 

 We have an exciting opportunity for a SQL Server Database Administrator / Developer t o join the team!

 The SQL Server Database Administrator / Developer will:
 Own the health, performance, and availability of the organization's SQL Server environment and the Windows servers that host it
 Perform proactive server and database maintenance, including patching, backups, restore testing, integrity checks, index maintenance, statistics updates, and transaction log management
 Monitor server and database performance, and identify and resolve issues before they affect users
 Tune database performance by analyzing execution plans, designing and maintaining indexes, and optimizing queries and stored procedures
 Design, write, and maintain complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions that support applications and reporting
 Build, schedule, and maintain data synchronization jobs between corporate databases and local systems using SQL Agent, SSIS, or similar tools, with monitoring and failure alerting
 Develop, deploy, and maintain SSRS reports, and support the reporting needs of business users
 Work with application developers to design efficient database schemas and data access patterns for .NET applications
 Manage database security, including logins, roles, and permissions, in line with organizational and contract requirements
 Maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures, and document the database environment and operational runbooks
 Requisition Qualifications 
 This position has been posted at multiple levels. Depending on the candidate's experience, requirements, and business needs, we reserve the right to consider candidates at any level for which this position has been advertised. 
 Typically requires a bachelor’s degree or equivalent certification in a related area and a minimum of 5 years of experience in the field or in a related area.
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience
 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and developing in Microsoft SQL Server.
 Proven experience with routine database maintenance: backup and recovery strategies, recovery models, transaction log management, integrity checks, and index and statistics maintenance
 Strong T-SQL skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning with execution plans
 Solid understanding of indexing strategy, including clustered and no clustered indexes, covering indexes, and fragmentation
 Experience building and supporting data integration and sync jobs with SQL Agent and/or SSIS
 Experience developing and maintaining SSRS reports
 Working knowledge of Windows Server administration as it relates to hosting SQL Server
 Basic understanding of .NET application development and how applications interact with the database, such as connection handling, Entity Framework or ADO.NET, and parameterized queries
 Strong troubleshooting skills and a disciplined, proactive approach to maintenance and documentation
 Requisition Preferences 
 Experience with PowerShell or dbatools for automating database administration tasks
 Familiarity with Power BI
 Experience using AI tools to support query writing, troubleshooting, or documentation
 Experience in aerospace, government contracting, or NASA/DoD environments
 Compensation: 
 Salary starts at $83,700. Final pay will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications.
   Why Join Our Team? 
 In addition to exciting career opportunities, we also ave:
 Excellent personal and professional career growth
 9/80 work schedule (every other Friday off), when applicable
 Onsite cafeteria (breakfast & lunch)
 Much, much more!
 For more information on our partnership with NASA at Johnson Space Center (JSC), please visit  www.wehavespaceforyou.com 
 Proof of U.S. Citizenship or US Permanent Residency may be a requirement for this position.
 Must be able to complete a U.S. government background investigation.
 Management has the prerogative to select at any level for which the position is advertised.
  
 Essential Functions 
 Work Environment 
 Generally, an office environment, but can involve inside or outside work depending on task.
 Physical Requirements 
 Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods (90% of time). May require lifting and carrying up to 25 lbs. (5% of time).
 Equipment and Machines 
 Standard office equipment (PC, telephone, printer, etc.).
 Attendance 
 Regular attendance in accordance with established work schedule is critical. Ability to work outside normal schedule and adjust schedule to meet peak periods and surge requirements.
 Other Essential Functions 
 Professional behavior that enhances productivity and promotes teamwork and cooperation. Grooming and dress must be appropriate for the position and must not impose a safety risk/hazard to the employee or others.
